note: Community-maintained Sprite catalog for Fortnite Cosmetics Browser. Epic has no public Sprite API, so this file is edited by hand. Add new sprites, variants or seasons here - both apps pick changes up without an update. Ids are permanent: never rename one, or saved progress is lost. Art: both apps look up '<Name> - Item - Fortnite.png' / '<Variant> <Name> - Item - Fortnite.png' (also '<Name> Sprite ...') on the Fortnite Wiki at runtime. Images come from Fortnite.GG: sprite "fgg" = internal name, variant "fgg" = icon suffix (https://fortnite.gg/img/x/sprites/icons/T_Icon_BR_Creature_Sprite_<fgg><suffix>_L.webp). Other optional per-sprite fields: "wiki" (exact wiki name), "image" (URL), "images" ({variantId: URL}).
